newsitem.title: ROMANIA: Romanian rollover T-bill issue oversubscribed.
newsitem.headline: Romanian rollover T-bill issue oversubscribed.

text.p: Romania's central bank said on Friday a 300 billion lei issue of Finance Ministry 63-day treasury bills had been heavily oversubscribed with bids exceeding offers by 200 billion.
The papers were offered with a coupon giving an annual yield of 51.48 percent.

Six banks -- Banca Romana de Comert Exterior Bancorex SA, Banc Post SA, Banca Romana pentru Dezvoltare SA, Casa de Economii si Consemnatiuni, Banca Agicola SA and Banca Comerciala Romana SA -- and their clients bought the bills, maturing on December 6.
